## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make app`
- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] `make doctor` (if engine behavior changed)
- [ ] Localization tables remain in sync (four languages)
- [ ] Real files used for manual testing stay local and uncommitted

## Scope and risk

- [ ] No network requests, telemetry, private APIs or new permissions
- [ ] Sources and existing outputs remain preserved / non-overwritten
- [ ] Release/build docs updated if packaging, versioning or support changed
- [ ] Manual visual/accessibility evidence recorded if UI/UX changed

## Notes

Mention known limitations, residual risks or follow-up work.
